messages:
maya (sec): FYI - restore jobs are failing for a handful of snapshots under `prod-db-snapshots/tenant-42/`. Error shows 'CEK-pointer-not-found' and some rows show header version mismatch. Not across the board but ~6 objects.
liam (encops): any recent key operations? rotation, re-encrypt, grant revocations?
maya (sec): rotation completed at ~22:54 UTC. Cloudtrail shows a rotate request; rotation-controller logs show several metadata update timeouts right after.
adrian (sre): example restore log: ```ERROR RestoreWorker: DecryptEnvelopeHeaderError: header_ver=v3 expected pointer tag 'kz' but got 'kx' ; lookup failed```. Also s3 head returns `x-amz-meta-encver: v3;pointer=encptr:oldk:0x7a`
sam (infra): pointer shows oldk reference. Looks like header re-wrap didn't finish for these objects. Could be transient network failure during metadata rewrite.
liam (encops): likely scenario: rotation is two-stage (rewrap header then re-encrypt payload), header rewrap step retried but gave up; old key was disabled soon after, so Decrypt of CEK pointer fails now.
nora (product): how bad is this? customer visible?
maya (sec): small number of customers attempting restores now; one support ticket opened. We should avoid re-enabling retired keys unless absolutely necessary.
liam (encops): mitigation options: 1) create an ephemeral KMS grant scoped to a 'rewrap-runner' principal to Decrypt with old_key and Encrypt with new_key; 2) if policy allows, temporarily re-enable old key (higher risk); 3) run an internal repair that reconstructs CEK pointers if we have backups of header metadata. I'm leaning to option 1.
adrian (sre): agree. we'll need a canary plan: pick 5 objects, rewrap their headers, run restore, validate DB checksum.
maya (sec): sec controls: require an approval post in #eng-security with grant ARN, runbook link, and restrict grant duration to 1 hour. All rewrap actions must be logged and shipped to SIEM in real time. No manual key re-enables without exec signoff.
sam (infra): RBAC note: uploader svcacct lost kms:Decrypt on old_key after rotation pruning. That matches why rolling rewrap job failed. The ephemeral grant must explicitly allow Decrypt: old_key and Encrypt: new_key.
liam (encops): drafting rewrap worker now. Pseudocode: ```go
// high level
meta := s3.HeadObject(bucket,key)
ptr := parsePtr(meta["x-amz-meta-encrypted-header"]) // base64 blob
plainCEK, err := kms.Decrypt(ctx, &kms.DecryptInput{KeyId: oldKey, CiphertextBlob: ptr})
newPtr, err := kms.Encrypt(ctx, &kms.EncryptInput{KeyId: newKey, Plaintext: plainCEK})
// update using conditional metadata update to avoid races
s3.CopyObject( {CopySource: src, Metadata: updatedMeta, MetadataDirective: "REPLACE"} )
```
liam (encops): worker will run with dedicated principal `service/rewrap-worker@redwood` and minimal iam. I'll post grant request details when ready.
adrian (sre): I'll assemble canary set and post verification checklist: pre-hash, post-restore hash, timing, success criteria.
maya (sec): add an allowlist for object prefixes (tenant-42 only) and require runbook signed by lead sec and infra. Also enable extra monitoring: count rewrap successes/fails, any KMS Deny events.
nora (product): keep me posted. I may need to proactively reach out to affected customers depending on ETA.
ops-bot: incident created IR-6591234567; severity P2, assigned to liam (encops) and adrian (sre).
liam (encops): timeline: will have grant request + runbook in ~30m, canary run after approval, full sweep if canary green.
maya (sec): good. capture all audit IDs and ticket numbers. we'll hold a short postmortem to update the rotation pipeline to be idempotent and to fail open in controlled way (i.e., delay key retirement until metadata rewraps verified).
liam (encops): noted - will add retries with exponential backoff and mark rewrap step as a blocking pre-rotation check.
adrian (sre): adding an alert for rotation-controller metadata rewrite failures >0.5% in next deploy.
maya (sec): approved approach. tag me on the grant approval post and attache the runbook. :lock:
liam (encops): updating thread with grant ARN + canary results after run.
